question: After archived-skill false positives are fixed, should warning-only skill-shadow visibility merge and close the linked issue without adding denyShadowing now?
rationale: The implementation preserves existing precedence and improves visibility, but deciding whether visibility is sufficient for reviewed-skill shadowing is a security/product policy choice.

options.title: Merge visibility-only after repair
options.body: Fix the archived-skill diagnostic bug, accept warning-only visibility as the current security hardening, and leave fail-closed denial for a separate maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Require strict policy first
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define and test an opt-in or default fail-closed deny-shadowing policy.

options.title: Narrow default warnings
options.body: Keep CLI/UI visibility but reduce or gate load-time and doctor warnings if intentional overrides are expected to be common.

recommendation.title: Merge visibility-only after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the archived-skill diagnostic bug, accept warning-only visibility as the current security hardening, and leave fail-closed denial for a separate maintainer-sponsored follow-up.
